# has permission

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPermission`](gmeow-hasPermission.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPermission>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

Relates a rights statement to a permission it grants (an [odrl:permission](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/permission) rule).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) -> [`gmeow:Permission`](../classes/gmeow-Permission.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasPermission`](gmeow-hasPermission.md) from [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) to [`gmeow:Permission`](../classes/gmeow-Permission.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
